macros.name: nmcRecur
macros.doc:
numerica-plus offers three new commands for three processes: 
mcIterate (short-name form \iter) for iterating functions, 
mcSolve (short-name form \solve) for finding the zeros or (local) extrema of functions, and 
mcRecur (short-name form ecur) for calculating terms of recurrence relations.
